task.title: Report an Incident at NC State
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to report an incident that happened at NC State on through its networks.

taskbody.context: To report a suspected incident, gather the following information and send it in an email to help@ncsu.edu or call the NC State Help Desk at (919) 515-4357:

step.cmd: Type of incident (select from the "Type of Incidents" list)

steps-unordered.step: Date and time of the incident

General description of event with the following information, if applicable:
Computer name
IP address of each computer involved
Logs from each computer involved
